who: Recruiters, office admins and company admins
overview: A **recruiter** posts jobs and works the applicants for the company. An **office admin** does the same for their own office and the offices under it, and can invite recruiters and hiring managers. The company must be verified before a job can be published; drafts need nothing.
can: See every job you may manage, with its applicants.
Post a job, save it as a draft, edit it, pause, resume and close it.
Read each applicant's résumé and answers, rate them, write notes for your team, and message them.
Move an applicant through the stages or reject them.
Schedule, move and cancel interviews, and choose the panel.
Make an offer and follow its answer.

rules: To go live a job needs a title, a description of a few lines, at least one skill, a country, and between 1 and 999 openings. Pay is optional.
If your company is not verified yet, **Publish** explains what is missing and opens the verification.
Your plan decides how many jobs can be live at once.
An applicant who was rejected, has withdrawn or was hired cannot be given an interview or an offer; move them back first.
Rejecting someone cancels their coming interviews and withdraws any offer not yet answered.

website: Talent search and inviting candidates to apply.
Rejecting or moving many applicants at once, and the review mode for a job with hundreds of applicants.
**Promote**, which pays for a boost; projects; hiring reports.
